definitions.any_metadata_error: At least one occurrence has metadata_judgment=metadata_error; different erroneous fields can coexist in one occurrence.
definitions.any_metadata_unresolved: At least one occurrence has metadata_judgment=unresolved. This flag does not count every open question or an explicitly uncertain field attached to an otherwise definite error.
definitions.counterpart_proposed: At least one candidate ID is listed in missed_merge_candidate_ids; this is a positive AI proposal within an incomplete duplicate search.
definitions.denominator_ids: Number of frozen sampled IDs in the specified sampling selection, with no design weights.
definitions.denominator_occurrences: All frozen original entries attached to those sampled IDs; repeated appearances remain separate occurrences.
definitions.explicitly_unresolved_occurrences: Occurrence has the named metadata_unresolved_fields value, regardless of its overall metadata judgment. Unresolved judgments without typed fields appear as unspecified. Field rows overlap.
definitions.flagged: Union of non-correct identity proposals, false/unresolved shared links, metadata_error or unresolved occurrence judgments, and positive or explicitly unresolved counterpart IDs.
definitions.identity_label: AI proposal about whether the original entries assigned to one sampled ID represent one study under the recorded version policy.
definitions.shared_link_label: AI proposal about the AR5/AR6 matched occurrences already assigned to the sampled ID; this does not adjudicate every counterpart or unsampled ID.

interpretation: These are unweighted descriptions of AI-coded proposals, not human-validated labels or population accuracy estimates.
The probability sample has unequal inclusion probabilities; no sampling weights or population extrapolation are used here.
Targeted supplements were selected for anomalies and are never pooled with the probability sample in a reported count.
Every duplicate search remains incomplete. Counterpart proposals do not estimate missed-merge rates, recall or their uncertainty.
A compound extracted entry can contain several works while preserving a real work shared by AR5 and AR6. Identity and shared-link labels answer different questions.
Metadata errors, metadata uncertainty, false merges and counterpart proposals can occur in the same ID. Their counts must not be added as disjoint errors.
An unresolved metadata field is not coded as a confirmed metadata error. Missing enriched fields alone do not establish an error.
No confidence intervals, weighted error estimates, corrected headline estimates or new bibliographic API responses are produced.
review_origin: AI-assisted initial textual/source review by Codex and delegated Codex agents
